**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

Section 4.4 ("Audit Rights") is the sole provision binding us on inspection, and it sits at the playbook's **preferred** position on all material terms:

| Term | Clause 4.4 | Playbook preferred |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | No more than once each calendar year | Once per 12 months ✓ |
| Notice / timing | Reasonable notice, at reasonable times | 30 days, business hours — substantially met |
| Auditor | Independent CPA reasonably acceptable to Corio | Independent auditor ✓ (approval right is better than preferred) |
| Cost | Commerce One bears all costs unless underpayment >5% | Vendor cost unless >5% ✓ |
| System access | Books and records only | No system access ✓ |

Two minor sub-elements fall short of the ideal wording — notice is "reasonable" rather than a fixed 30 (or fallback 15) days, and the auditor is not expressly subject to a confidentiality undertaking beyond its professional obligations. Under the playbook's classification semantics these are noted rather than flagged, so no redline was proposed. If the section is reopened for another reason, we would slot in a quantified notice period and a confidentiality covenant for the auditor.
